title: LMU-PVT_Safety, technical and clinical success rate of interventional portal vein recanalization
summary: Data sources include pre- and post-interventional imaging (MRI, CT, duplex sonography) of the abdomen as well as data stored in the Clinical Information System and Radiological Information System. Data collection at the respective center is carried out in pseudonymized form, data transmission in anonymized form.

interventions.name: This is a retrospective multicenter study design in which all the data to be analyzed is already available. The corresponding clinical and image files from the external centers are evaluated on site by experienced study physicians and processed in anonymized form.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Patients with a diagnosis of portal vein thrombosis and who have undergone interventional recanalization.
Exclusion criteria:
Liver cirrhosis or tumor-associated portal vein thrombosis 
Budd-Chiari syndrome (thrombosis of the hepatic veins) with consecutive thrombosis of the portal vein.
